statements.subject: message
statements.description: PLAY_NOTIFY requests with Notify-Reason header set to media-properties-update MUST include a Media-Properties and Date header and SHOULD include a Media-Range header.
actions: include Media-Properties header in PLAY_NOTIFY request
include Date header in PLAY_NOTIFY request

statements.subject: message
statements.description: PLAY_NOTIFY requests with Notify-Reason header set to media-properties-update MUST include a Media-Properties and Date header and SHOULD include a Media-Range header.
actions: include Media-Range header in PLAY_NOTIFY request

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The Media-Properties header has session scope; thus, for aggregated sessions, the PLAY_NOTIFY request MUST use the aggregated control URI.
statements.pre_cond: session.type = aggregated & message.type = PLAY_NOTIFY & message.notify_reason = media-properties-update
actions: set PLAY_NOTIFY request URI to session aggregated control URI

statements.subject: server
statements.description: This notification MUST be sent for media that are time-progressing every time an event happens that changes the basis for making estimates on how the available for play-back media range will progress with wall clock time.
actions: send PLAY_NOTIFY request with Notify-Reason: media-properties-update

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In addition, it is RECOMMENDED that the server send these notifications approximately every 5 minutes for time-progressing content to ensure the long-term stability of the client estimation and allow for clock skew detection by the client.
actions: send PLAY_NOTIFY request with Notify-Reason: media-properties-update at approximately 5-minute intervals

statements.subject: message
statements.description: For the reasons just explained, requests MUST include a Media-Range header to provide current Media duration and a Range header to indicate the current playing point and any remaining parts of the requested range.
actions: include Media-Range header indicating current media duration in PLAY_NOTIFY request
include Range header indicating current playing point and remaining requested range in PLAY_NOTIFY request

statements.subject: message
statements.description: A PLAY_NOTIFY request with Notify-Reason header set to media-properties-update MUST NOT carry a message body.
actions: omit message body from PLAY_NOTIFY request
